name: Rifampicin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: HIV protease inhibitors (atazanavir, darunavir, fosamprenavir, saquinavir, tipranavir) and some other antiretrovirals
key_interactions.effect: Large fall in antiretroviral levels; resistance; severe liver toxicity with ritonavir-boosted saquinavir (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Isoniazid, halothane and other hepatotoxic drugs
key_interactions.action: Monitor liver function closely; avoid halothane.
Check prothrombin time daily or as needed to set the dose.
Switch to non-hormonal contraception during rifampin.

key_interactions.effect: More active metabolite and bleeding risk (label).

key_interactions.action: Monitor blood levels and adjust doses.
Measure digoxin before starting; increase the dose by about 20 to 40% as needed.
Itraconazole not recommended from 2 weeks before and during; see caspofungin dosing.

key_interactions.effect: Weaker glucocorticoid effect; adrenal crisis reported in Addison's disease (label).
key_interactions.action: The corticosteroid dose may need to increase.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Calcium channel blockers, beta-blockers, statins, losartan, enalapril
key_interactions.action: Monitor blood pressure and response; adjust doses.

key_interactions.effect: Much lower levels; methadone withdrawal reported (label).
